# Outbound — Persona 4: Local Businesses (trades, clinics, food, services)

Who: local businesses with no site, a 5-year-old site, or social-only presence:
no online booking/quote path, missing hours/prices, invisible on Maps-adjacent
search. Find them: Google Maps listings without websites, Facebook-only
businesses, "request a quote" dead-ends, community group recommendations.

Tone: plain language, zero jargon. They buy calls/bookings, not websites.

## Personalization variables (fill ALL before sending — ~3 min research)

- `[FirstName]` — owner's first name (or "there" fallback: "Hi there —")
- `[Business]` — business name
- `[Trade]` — what they do ("plumbing", "dental clinic", "takeaway")
- `[SpecificObservation]` — ONE concrete thing (e.g. "your Facebook page sends everyone to Messenger and the last reply took 4 days")
- `[ConcreteFix]` — ONE plain-language fix (e.g. "a one-page site with photos of past jobs, prices, and a tap-to-call button")
- `[DayOption]` — two specific days

## Anti-spam rules (all 4 templates)

1. Plain language only — no "SEO", "stack", "conversion funnel". Say "more calls".
2. First two lines must contain `[SpecificObservation]`.
3. One follow-up max, 5–7 days later (local owners check email less), then drop.
4. Every message includes an easy out. Max 10 new prospects/day. No automation.
5. Never promise rankings, customers, or revenue. Quote fixed prices only from the calculator.

---

## 4A. Email — the missed-calls pitch

Subject: quick idea for `[Business]` — more `[calls/bookings]`?

> Hi `[FirstName]`,
>
> Found `[Business]` through `[Google Maps / Facebook / referral]` — `[SpecificObservation]`.
>
> I'm local-ish and build simple one-page sites for `[Trade]` businesses whose
> whole job is turning lookers into `[calls/bookings]`: `[ConcreteFix]`. Fixed
> price agreed upfront, no monthly fees for the site itself.
>
> I do $5 idea calls (60 min): we plan your page and you get a fixed quote —
> yours to keep even if we don't build together. Open `[DayOption]`?
>
> If you're booked solid already, just say so — I'll close this out, no more
> messages.
>
> — `[YourName]`, `[phone]` · `[portfolio/GitHub link]`

## 4B. LinkedIn DM (many local owners aren't active here — prefer email/Facebook; use only if profile is active)

> Hi `[FirstName]` — I came across `[Business]` and noticed
> `[SpecificObservation]`. For `[Trade]` businesses I usually suggest
> `[ConcreteFix]` — one page that turns searches into `[calls/bookings]`.
>
> Fixed price upfront, $5 planning call where you keep the plan either way.
> Worth a chat `[DayOption]`, or are you fully booked already?

## 4C. Discord/Slack/Facebook-group DM — only where the group welcomes local recommendations, and only after being a genuine member

> hi `[FirstName]` — saw `[Business]` mentioned here, looked you up:
> `[SpecificObservation]`.
>
> I build simple one-page sites for `[Trade]` folks — typically
> `[ConcreteFix]`. Fixed price, no tech headaches, you own everything. I do a
> $5 planning call where the plan's yours to keep. Mentioning it in case the
> after-hours messages are getting out of hand — no worries if not needed!

## 4D. Follow-up (ONE, 5–7 days later)

Subject: Re: quick idea for `[Business]` — more `[calls/bookings]`?

> Hi `[FirstName]` — one check-in: is `[ConcreteFix]` for `[Business]` worth
> a $5 planning call, or should I close this out?
>
> No worries either way — if things get quieter in `[slow season]` I'm easy
> to find.
>
> — `[YourName]`, `[phone]`

(No second follow-up. Log outcome, move on.)
